# Kyoto Kimono Rental wargo

> > Traditional kimono and yukata rental service across Japan with locations in Kyoto, Tokyo, Osaka, Kanazawa, and Kawagoe, offering photoshoots, formal wear, and delivery options.

wargo operates multiple kimono rental shops throughout Japan, providing tourists and locals with authentic Japanese traditional clothing experiences. The service includes casual kimono and yukata rentals, formal wear for graduations and ceremonies, couple plans, photoshoot packages, and nationwide delivery rental options.

## Key Topics

- wargo kimono rental
- Kyoto traditional clothing
- Tourist kimono experiences
- Formal kimono (furisode, hakama)
- Yukata rental
- Kanazawa Korinbo shop
- Tokyo Ginza & Asakusa locations
- Osaka Shinsaibashi
- Online booking discounts
- Full-set rental packages
- Photoshoot plans
- Couple kimono plans
- Graduation hakama
- Nationwide delivery service
- Student discounts

## Rental Plans & Pricing

- [Standard Kimono Plan (Kanazawa)](https://kyotokimonorental.com/shop/10/plan/standard): Kanazawa standard kimono plan from ¥3,300 for beginners
- [Couple Kimono Plan (Kanazawa)](https://kyotokimonorental.com/shop/10/plan/couple): Kanazawa couple kimono rental plan with ¥3,300 discount at wargo
- [Luxury Furisode Plan (Kyoto)](https://kyotokimonorental.com/shop/100/plan/luxury-furisode): Luxury furisode plan in Kyoto from ¥56,100 with insurance included
- [Graduation Hakama Plan (Kyoto)](https://kyotokimonorental.com/shop/6/plan/deluxe-hakama): Kyoto graduation hakama plan from ¥67,100 with insurance included
- [Furisode Stroll Plan (Osaka Shinsaibashi)](https://kyotokimonorental.com/shop/28/plan/osanpo-furisode): Osaka Shinsaibashi furisode stroll plan from ¥11,000 for casual wear
- [Mamechiyo Modern Kimono Plan (Kanazawa)](https://kyotokimonorental.com/shop/10/plan/mamechiyo): Kanazawa Mamechiyo Modern kimono plan with retro-modern designs
- [Yukata Rental Plans](https://kyotokimonorental.com/plan/yukata): Yukata rental plans for festivals, fireworks & dates across Japan
